s-easy.title: Easy run

sections.label: Ceiling
sections.text: Alert at HR {{.Athlete.HR.easyCap}}. When it fires, walk until it clears.

sections.label: Pace
sections.text: An output, not a target. Expect {{var "easyBand"}}.

s-easy.why: Most weekly running minutes belong here. The share, not the pace, is what the block turns on.

sections.label: Ceiling
sections.text: HR {{.Athlete.HR.easyCap}}, same as any easy run.

sections.label: Shape
sections.text: The week's one hard run. Full warm-up and full cool-down, always.

sections.label: When
sections.text: Any time of day, but every day.

sections.label: Set up
sections.text: Half-kneeling, back toe tucked, front knee over the ankle.

sections.label: Do
sections.text: Tuck the pelvis, squeeze the down-side glute, then lean forward an inch.

sections.label: Error
sections.text: Leaning from the lumbar spine. If you feel it in your low back, you are arching, not stretching.
